result.title: Investigating Linux Vulnerabilities with GPT-6 Cyber
result.description:
AI can help security teams move faster from finding vulnerabilities to getting fixes into the software people rely on.

In one run, GPT-6 Cyber helped validate 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities and generate candidate patches for human review.

Cyber researcher Kyle Zeng sits down with Clint Gibler, applied cyber research lead, to discuss how he built the vulnerability research pipeline and worked with Linux maintainers to get fixes upstream.

Read the full research:
https://openai.com/index/a-thousand-fewer-paths-to-root/

result.title: How Franklin Templeton uses AI for investment research | OpenAI
result.description:
“Just delivering data is not enough.”

Franklin Templeton’s Katrina Dudley explains how OpenAI is helping the firm connect information from compliance, risk and trading, then turn it into insights for portfolio managers.

That gives analysts more time in the field, talking to private companies and developing their next investment idea.

See how AI is changing the work behind investment decisions—and creating more room for the research and judgment that shape an idea.

Read the full story: https://openai.com/index/franklin-templeton/
